test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The budget proposals will have been finalized by the finance ministry before the end of the fiscal year.

options.text: The finance ministry has finalized the budget proposals before the end of the fiscal year.
The finance ministry will be finalizing the budget proposals before the end of the fiscal year.
The finance ministry finalizes the budget proposals before the end of the fiscal year.
The finance ministry will have finalized the budget proposals before the end of the fiscal year.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The sentence "The budget proposals will have been finalized by the finance ministry..." is in the **Future Perfect Passive** tense (will have been + past participle).
 
• To convert to active voice: The agent "the finance ministry" becomes the subject of the sentence.
 
• Maintain the tense: The Future Perfect Passive "will have been finalized" changes to the **Future Perfect Active** form, which is "will have finalized."
 
• The object "the budget proposals" is placed after the verb, followed by the remaining time phrase.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The finance ministry will have finalized the budget proposals before the end of the fiscal year."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The finance ministry has finalized..." – Incorrect tense (Present Perfect).
 
• **Option 2: **"The finance ministry will be finalizing..." – Incorrect tense (Future Continuous).
 
• **Option 3: **"The finance ministry finalizes..." – Incorrect tense (Simple Present).
